schemas.label: Minimalist Professional
schemas.description: Clean, distraction-free design for productivity and finance apps

rtlOverrides.notes: Geometric patterns remain symmetric when flipped. Text alignment handled by compositing engine.

schemas.label: Energetic Tech
schemas.description: Bold, dynamic design with vibrant gradients for tech and gaming

rtlOverrides.notes: Organic shapes maintain visual balance when flipped horizontally. Animated gradients flow naturally for RTL.

schemas.label: Organic Health
schemas.description: Natural, wellness-focused design for health, fitness, and lifestyle apps

rtlOverrides.notes: Nature-inspired curves mirror gracefully. Soft shadows remain subtle in RTL composition.

schemas.label: High Contrast Bold
schemas.description: Accessible, eye-catching design with maximum contrast for sports and action

rtlOverrides.notes: Angular geometry remains powerful when mirrored. High contrast ensures readability in both directions.

schemas.label: Luxury Premium
schemas.description: Elegant, sophisticated design for premium and luxury-tier apps

rtlOverrides.notes: Elegant proportions maintain luxury feel when flipped. Refined shadows adapt to RTL geometry.

metadata.description: Static theme store for playstore.xyz ASO platform. All schemas support full LTR/RTL parity via flop-composite-flop pipeline. RTL overrides specify behavior for Arabic and Hebrew locales.

designPhilosophy.rtlSupport: All color palettes and shape languages are designed to mirror gracefully. The compositing engine (Sharp) handles geometric transformation; schema defines the creative intent.
designPhilosophy.colorParity: Primary/secondary/accent colors chosen for equal luminance and contrast in both directions.
designPhilosophy.symmetry: Organic and geometric shapes tested to maintain visual balance when horizontally flipped.

fontStyles.clean: Sans-serif, geometric proportions. System: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto
fontStyles.bold: Bold sans-serif with high weight (700+). High visual impact.
fontStyles.elegant: Serif or high-precision sans-serif. Refined proportions.

luminanceGuidelines.very-high: Light backgrounds (90%+ lightness). Text: dark. High readability.
luminanceGuidelines.high: Light-medium backgrounds (70-90% lightness). Flexible text color.
luminanceGuidelines.medium: Mid-tone backgrounds (50-70% lightness). High contrast required.
luminanceGuidelines.dark: Dark backgrounds (30-50% lightness). Light text only.

gestureProfiles.flowing: Smooth transitions and gentle curves. Natural feel.
